notes: «791 -» is a report number; «اَلْعَبْدَ اَلصَّالِحَ» is an honorific before the name and is left out; «سَأَلَ ... أَخَاهُ» style: the asker and the one asked are two links (rule 5); «إِنَّ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ... كَانَ يَقُولُ» names Baqir as the source of a quoted saying inside the matn, so he is not added (rule 7; doubt); «عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ» is a blessing; the matn begins at «عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ»
